{{Quote|I saw this planet once, with Master Kiwiiks. It used to be green.|Kira Carsen|<ref name="Uphrades" />}}
'''Uphrades''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Uphrades system/Legends|Uphrades system]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. Originally a [[Color/Legends|green]] and fertile [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] during the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] leading up to the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], Uphrades supplied the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] with much of its [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] supplies. This earned it the nickname "'''Coruscant's Granary'''" until the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]] targeted the agriworld during his [[Desolator crisis|campaign of vengeance]] in [[3643 BBY]].

As part of his revenge against the Republic and the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] for the [[Duel in the Jedi Temple ruins|death]] of his [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]], Angral tested the [[Desolator (superweapon)|Desolator]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] on Uphrades and [[Devastation of Uphrades|devastated]] its surface, [[Death/Legends|killing]] millions and trapping the few hundred survivors on the planet by [[Ion cannon/Legends|ionizing]] its [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. Thanks to the efforts of [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Senessa]] and the crew of the Republic [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] ''[[Daybreaker]]'', the survivors endured the several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] it took for the ion field to dissipate, but the planet itself remained a desolate and barren world.

==Description==
{{Quote|There's virtually no vegetation left. Even the oceans are boiling.|Doctor [[Nasan Godera]]|<ref name="Uphrades" />}}
Located in the [[Uphrades system/Legends|Uphrades system]],<ref name="Uphrades" /> a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] near the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]] in the slice of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] that lay between the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] and the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]] [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]]&mdash;part of the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]]<ref name="AtlasPlacement" />&mdash;Uphrades was a [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] throughout much of its history.<ref name="Uphrades" /> The terrestrial planet's soil was especially rich thanks to a significant amount of [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] activity some [[23,643 BBY|20,000]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Uphrades also possessed a temperate climate with a Type I [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] breathable<ref name="Uphrades" /> for [[Human/Legends|Humans]]<ref name="Planets of the Galaxy" /> and significant surface [[Water/Legends|water]] separating its five continents.<ref name="Uphrades" />

However, when the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Angral]] used the [[Desolator (superweapon)|Desolator]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] on the planet, Uphrades' surface was torn apart, and its atmosphere turned into an enormous [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]]. Large chunks of the planet's crust were ripped away, exposing pockets of [[Magma/Legends|magma]] and forming an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] around the world, while the missing pieces of the crust left behind craters. The planet's [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] were vaporized, and its green surface turned to ash, leaving behind rocky plains and canyons with rivers of lava.<ref name="Uphrades" />

==History==
{{Quote|That agriworld supplies nearly half of Coruscant's food&hellip; Any damage to Uphrades' food production could cripple the Republic.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]]|<ref name="Uphrades" />}}
[[File:Uphradespre.png|thumb|left|220px|Uphrades, before the devastation of its surface]]
Approximately 1,500 years after the [[25,053 BBY|founding of the Republic]], Uphrades experienced a large amount of volcanic activity that caused the world's soil to become especially rich over the next twenty millennia.<ref name="Uphrades" /> The planet fell within the extent of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] that the Galactic Republic had explored as of the beginning of the [[Great Manifest Period/Legends|Great Manifest Period]] by the year [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]], and the Uphrades system fell within the Republic's boundaries throughout the rest of the Republic's history until its reorganization into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> By the end of the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire,<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Uphrades was a fertile agriworld that supplied a large portion of the [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] for the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. This earned it the nickname "Coruscant's Granary" by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the Cold War,<ref name="Uphrades" /> when the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Syo Bakarn]] and the [[Jedi Restoration Concord]] worked with the people of Uphrades to quadruple the planet's food production in just two years.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

Sometime between [[3645 BBY]]<ref name="The Defector">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Defector|Abandoned Mining Facility}}</ref><ref name="The Merciful One">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Merciful One|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> and [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master [[Bela Kiwiiks]] visited the planet with her new [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Kira Carsen]]. However, Uphrades became a target of the Sith [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Angral during his [[Desolator crisis|crusade]] against the Republic<ref name="Uphrades" /> in 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].<ref name="Time" /> In an attempt to exact revenge on the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the Republic for the [[Duel in the Jedi Temple ruins|death]] of his [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]], at the hands of a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]],<ref name="Race to the Ruins">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Race to the Ruins|Coruscant}}</ref> Angral brought the Desolator superweapon to bear on Uphrades. Constructed using stolen Republic weapons technologies, the Desolator ionized Uphrades' atmosphere, trapping all 16 million inhabitants on the world before destabilizing the planet's core through seismic vibrations. The [[Devastation of Uphrades|attack]] devastated Uphrades' surface, [[Death/Legends|killing]] millions and leaving only a few hundred survivors on the planet.<ref name="Uphrades" />

{{GameLS}}
The Republic [[Hospital ship/Legends|medical frigate]] ''[[Daybreaker]]'' was in the Uphrades system when Angral's [[Warship/Legends|warship]], the [[Harrower-class dreadnought|dreadnought]] [[Oppressor (Harrower-class)|''Oppressor'']], arrived and attacked the planet, and wreckage from Uphrades' surface damaged the ''Daybreaker''. An Imperial boarding party subsequently [[Attack on the Daybreaker|attacked]] the disabled [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]], but a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]&mdash;Tarnis's killer and the target of Angral's wrath&mdash;arrived just in time to stop the assault. After the attack, the ''Daybreaker''{{'s}} medical [[Officer/Legends|officer]], [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Senessa]], detected survivors on the surface, and she decided to take the frigate down to deliver aid. The [[Starship/Legends|ship's]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]], the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Dal (Cathar)|Dal]], objected when he learned that the ''Daybreaker'' would be disabled and unable to leave the planet if they entered the atmosphere and decided to take an [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] rather than sacrifice himself for the survivors.<ref name="Uphrades" /> With the supplies aboard the ''Daybreaker'', Senessa and the ship's crew ensured that those on the surface survived the several [[Standard month/Legends|months]] that it took for the atmosphere's ionization to dissipate. Once Republic aid ships were able to enter the atmosphere safely, the survivors and the ''Daybreaker''{{'s}} crew were rescued.<ref name="Message">{{TORcite|type=message|News from Uphrades|Doctor Senessa}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|Uphrades had millions of citizens&hellip; whole continents of farmlands.|General Var Suthra|<ref name="Uphrades" />}}
In the [[Standard day/Legends|days]] before Angral's attack, Uphrades boasted a population of 16 million [[Farm/Legends|farmers]] and food [[Tech specialist|technologists]], spread out across Uphrades' five continents. However, the catastrophic effects of the Desolator killed almost all of those 16 million people, leaving less than a thousand survivors.<ref name="Uphrades" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Uphrades-system.png|thumb|right|240px|The player's ship passes Uphrades on its way to the ''Daybreaker''.]]
Uphrades first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Jedi Knight class storyline. The devastation of Uphrades and the attack on the ''Daybreaker'' appear in the Jedi Knight mission "Uphrades" and feature one major alignment choice. Dal presents a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark-side]] option when he asks the Knight to convince Senessa that the [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] readings showing signs of life on Uphrades are false and that there are no survivors, as Dal wants to return to his family. As a reward, the captain offers to bribe the player with medical supplies from the ''Daybreaker''{{'s}} stock.<ref name="Uphrades" /> 

The [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light-side]] option of refusing his offer results in Dal taking an escape pod while Senessa and the crew of the ''Daybreaker'' travel down to the surface, despite knowing that they will be unable to leave.<ref name="Uphrades" /> Senessa will later send a message of thanks to the player, confirming that the people on the surface will be able to survive until the atmosphere becomes safe again and the Republic can launch rescue efforts.<ref name="Message" />
